scheme_name: Financial Assistance On Marriage Of Children (HBOCWWB)
other_conditions: The worker must be registered under the Haryana Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (HBOCWWB).
The registered worker must have a minimum of one year regular membership.
The worker must possess an attested marriage card of his/her son or daughter.
The worker must submit the marriage certificate in writing within six months to the concerned Assistant Director; failure to do so makes them ineligible for future welfare benefits.
The worker must provide an undertaking/self‑declaration that they have not received this assistance from any other government department, board or corporation.
Financial assistance is payable for the marriage of up to two children of the beneficiary, but can be extended to three daughters.
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹21,000 for a son's marriage and ₹50,000 for a daughter's marriage, payable for up to two children (extendable to three daughters).
documents_required: Attested marriage card of the son/daughter
Undertaking/self‑declaration that assistance has not been received from any other government department/board/corporation
